entries.name: Telemetry standard
entries.supported_claim: Vendor-neutral traces, metrics, logs, context, and OTLP specifications.
entries.best_use: Keep transport and trace concepts portable.
entries.important_boundary: GenAI semantic-convention maturity and captured-data policy.

entries.name: AI semantic conventions
entries.supported_claim: Semantic conventions and instrumentation for AI application traces.
entries.best_use: Normalize spans across model, retrieval, and agent frameworks.
entries.important_boundary: Compatibility with the chosen backend and privacy policy.

entries.name: Instrumentation SDK
entries.supported_claim: OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation for LLM application frameworks/providers.
entries.best_use: Add automatic tracing while retaining OTLP export.
entries.important_boundary: Exactly which inputs/outputs are captured and redacted.

entries.name: Self-hosted tracing/evals
entries.supported_claim: Open-source LLM engineering platform for traces, prompts, evaluations, and metrics.
entries.best_use: Teams wanting a broad self-hostable application layer.

entries.name: Open-source AI observability
entries.supported_claim: Tracing, evaluation, and analysis for AI applications.
entries.best_use: Inspect retrieval, model, and agent behavior locally or in a service.

entries.name: OpenTelemetry-native platform
entries.supported_claim: Open-source observability and evaluation components oriented around OpenTelemetry.
entries.important_boundary: Supported integrations and default data capture.

entries.name: LLM gateway/observability
entries.supported_claim: Open-source gateway and observability platform for LLM requests.
entries.important_boundary: Traffic routing implications and sensitive payload retention.

entries.name: Collector/backend
entries.best_use: Correlate agent traces with service metrics and logs.
entries.important_boundary: AI-specific views and semantics may require custom dashboards.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
